answer.reason: The verses tell of Azariah (Abednego) being set over Babylon's affairs and surviving the fiery furnace for refusing to worship the golden image.

clauses.english: was set over the affairs of the province of Babylon at Daniel's request
clauses.quote: he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon

clauses.english: was cast into the burning fiery furnace for refusing to worship the golden image, and came out unharmed
clauses.quote: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

doubts: Azariah is called Abednego in DAN 1:7; verses naming Abednego were taken to be about him.
The furnace clause cites a wide run because the deed (bound, cast in, preserved) is told across those verses.
